name: novel-chapters
description: Draft or revise one assigned chapter from scene plans, current canon, causal context, and the narrative contract.
procedure: Verify the assigned chapter and scene-plan identifiers; never mutate another target.
Read the compiler-built context pack and retrieve outward only by stable identifier when a required fact is missing.
Draft from explicit scene goals, obstacles, turns, outcomes, entry state, and exit state while honoring the narrative contract.
Apply one stale-safe patch to the build-bound chapter branch and update only assigned scene metadata.
Persist a schema-valid chapter-draft artifact and report observable evidence.
